newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African JSE all-share index at new closing high.
newsitem.headline: S.African JSE all-share index at new closing high.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange's (JSE) all share index ended at a record high of 7,071.53 on Monday, the exchange said in a statement.
It said the previous closing high of 7,070.24 was recorded on April 22 1996.
But the new level is not the highest the JSE has ever traded. The life intra-day trading high is 7,086.8 -- set on April 26 earlier this year.
The South African market has been steadily rising recently tracking Wall Street which has attempted to decisively break through the psychologically important 6,000 barrier.
On Monday the Dow opened strongly and surged 45 points to 6,014 in a broad-based rally.

But the JSE broke its record in a quieter mood as moderate trade was led forward by futures dealing and gold shares were supported by the first raft of results from the gold quarterly reporting season.
The JSE was not immediately available for comment.
